sweepDescription.model: Existing 5 V converter is a constant-power load, with a 6 V numerical floor after failure. Motor encoder and gate loads use constant current. Sensor loading is resistive below 9 V. Steps last 2 ms on a running rail.
sweepDescription.screen: Minimum shared rail 11.4 V and minimum sensor port 6 V over the modeled step. Passing does not demonstrate sensor boot or thermal margin.

regulatedOutputRangeV.basis: In regulation with 1% divider resistors and 0.588–0.612 V reference. A 60 nA ADJ bias allowance uses the datasheet test condition. Startup, dropout and component faults are outside this calculation.

limitations: Bounded engineering scenarios; frequency, effective capacitance, regulator response and gate-driver budgets require measurement. No switching-loop or manufacturer macro-model.
Existing electronics are modeled as a matched resistive load for transient screening; use DC budget for the constant-power 5 V converter envelope.
Unknown sensor startup is swept as an equivalent load. A current-limited sensor may brown out or restart; the model cannot predict successful boot.
The 10% current-limit spread is a screen extrapolated from the LT3065 test conditions, not a guaranteed 12 V/9 V specification. Thermal foldback, cable and cold startup are not modeled.
